faq.a1: Yes. There are no ads, no fees and no paid version. It is made by The Skyward Project.
faq.a2: Only to load the app the first time, and the first time you read a photo. After that most of Saath works offline.
faq.q3: If I lose my phone, is my progress lost?
faq.a3: Yes, unless you saved a backup file. Saath has no server copy. Save a backup in Settings from time to time.
faq.a4: Verena is fictional. The money rules in her story, the guides and the forms are checked against official sources. The real stories section is real, with sources.
faq.q5: Will Saath tell me what to invest in or whether to take a loan?
faq.a5: No. Saath explains how things work and what to check. The decision is yours. Talk to someone you trust before you sign.

privacy.title: Privacy, in plain words
privacy.p1: Your account is a username and password kept in this browser on this device. There is no Saath server holding accounts.
privacy.p2: The password itself is never stored. A salted hash is, so the app can check it.
privacy.p3: Your progress, Money Lab entries and chat are saved in this browser. They are not encrypted, so anyone who can open this browser's storage on this device could read them.
privacy.p4: Nothing moves to another device by itself. To move, save a backup file in Settings and open it on the other device.
privacy.p5: Photos of forms and receipts are read on this device and thrown away. They are never saved or uploaded.
privacy.p6: Saath AI answers on this device unless you switch on the online model. Even then, identity numbers are removed and Money Lab data is never sent.

partners.title: Privacy for teachers and partners
partners.b1: Saath has no server of its own. Each person makes a username and password that exist only in that browser; the password is stored as a salted PBKDF2 hash, never as text. Each account's tracker entries, lesson, story and path progress, chat history (if kept), drill and FinLit Check results, and optional school code and grade are stored in that browser's storage, kept apart per account. This storage is not encrypted.
partners.b2: Photos of forms and receipts, the text read from them, tracker entries, tracked loans, usernames, passwords and individual answers. Saath collects no real names, phone numbers, emails, locations or device identifiers, and has no analytics, advertising or behavioural profiling. Saath AI answers on the device unless a hosted model is configured and the person switches it on; even then Money Lab data is never sent.
partners.b3: A student who has joined a school can switch on sharing. It is off by default. When it is on, and only if this deployment has an endpoint configured, Saath sends small anonymous events: the school code, the grade, the kind of event (joined, a FinLit Check before or after, a lesson or path finished) and, for a check, four unit scores. No name, nickname or device identifier is included.
partners.b4: The partner view shows totals for a school and grade: students joined, lessons and paths finished, and the average change per unit between the first and second FinLit Check. It never shows an individual student, and any group smaller than ten is hidden.
partners.b5: Settings has “Delete this account”, which removes the account and everything it saved in that browser, and “Delete my progress and entries”. Anonymous events already sent cannot be traced back to a student, so they cannot be picked out and removed.
partners.b6: Saath is used by minors. Before any cloud sync, server-side accounts or new data collection is added, a qualified person must review it against India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, including the rules on children's data and verifiable parental consent.

play.title: Decide, then see what happens
play.lead: Every part of Verena's story ends in a choice. Try one now.
play.story: It is the 18th. Verena opens her banking app and sees ₹350. There are twelve days left in the month.
play.question: What should she do?
play.option0: Borrow ₹2,000 from a friend and sort it out next month
play.option1: Write down every rupee she has spent, and plan ₹29 a day until the 1st
play.option2: Ask her parents to send next month's money early
play.outcome0: She gets through the month. Next month starts ₹2,000 short, and the same thing happens by the 14th.
play.outcome1: It is a tight twelve days, but she finds two app subscriptions she had forgotten and cancels them.
play.outcome2: Her parents send it. The month is fine, but next month is shorter, and nothing has changed in how she spends.
play.lesson: Why: you cannot plan money you have not tracked. Writing it down is the first step of every budget.

settings.aiOnlineNone: This copy of Saath has no online model, so nothing you ask is sent anywhere.
settings.aiOrder: Saath uses the model in this browser if it is on, then the online model if allowed, then its checked guides.
settings.focusLead: Saath uses this to suggest what to read and revise.
settings.signedInAs: Logged in as {name} on this device.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete the account {name} and everything it saved in this browser? This cannot be undone.
settings.accountNote: Accounts exist only in this browser. Saved data is not encrypted, so anyone who can open this browser's storage can read it.
settings.dataLead: Everything stays in this browser. A backup file is the only way to move it to another device.
settings.eraseConfirm: Delete this account's progress, Money Lab entries and goal from this device? The account stays. This cannot be undone.
settings.schoolLead: Joined Saath through The Skyward Project? Enter the code your team gave you. It links you to your class without your name.
settings.schoolLeft: You have left the school programme.

install.title: Install Saath
install.why: Installed, Saath opens like an app and works without a connection.
install.done: Saath is installed on this device.
install.later: No problem. You can install it later from here.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.android2: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.desktop1: Look for the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
install.note: Installing does not share anything. Your data stays on this device.
